office: the General Authority for State Registration, at the state registration departments of the capital's 9 districts and the 21 aimags
note: The electronic ordinary passport's price from the General Authority for State Registration's own services page (undated, its footer © 2020; read 2026-11-03): 77,500 tögrög and a 5,000-tögrög stamp duty, 82,500 in all, for a first passport or one replacing an expired or full one; a lost one is replaced for 155,000, the 5,000 stamp and a 30,000 fine, 190,000 in all, written as a replacement route. Until 2026-11-03 the price stood on ikon.mn's report of the Authority's announcement (1 March 2023), and the lost passport's wasn't modelled. A damaged one is replaced for 185,000 (a 25,000 fine), which isn't a route the form holds. Validity and processing time aren't read.
